name: Saurabh Kumar
bio: Professor and BYD Seal owner — and one of the first members of the AUREL community.

cars.story: Drives a black BYD Seal — BYD's all-electric performance saloon, in Cosmos Black.

name: Cristiano Ronaldo
bio: Portuguese forward and five-time Ballon d'Or winner, regarded as one of the greatest footballers of all time.

cars.story: Reported to have added a Bugatti Chiron to his collection in 2017, and has since been photographed driving it in Lisbon.
Widely reported in 2020 to be among the buyers of the Bugatti Centodieci, a limited run of just ten cars, following a Serie A title with Juventus.
Received a Rolls-Royce Dawn convertible as a Christmas gift in December 2022, as shown in a video shared on Instagram and reported by the press.

name: Zlatan Ibrahimović
bio: Swedish striker who won league titles in four countries during a career spanning more than two decades.

cars.story: Reported to have treated himself to a custom Ferrari Monza SP2, one of 499 SP1/SP2 cars, to mark his 38th birthday.
Took delivery of a matte-black Ferrari F80 with yellow detailing in October 2025, sharing the moment in a video on social media.

name: Max Verstappen
bio: Dutch racing driver and multiple Formula 1 World Champion with Red Bull Racing.

cars.story: Tested Valkyrie prototypes during the hypercar's development and is reported to be one of its owners.
Reported to have bought a Porsche 911 GT3 RS in 2016, one of his first major purchases after his Formula 1 debut.
Was presented with a Honda NSX Type S by Honda at its Racing Thanks Day event in Japan in late 2022.

name: Lando Norris
bio: British racing driver for McLaren and the 2025 Formula 1 World Champion.

cars.story: Reported to own a one-of-one McLaren 765LT Spider commissioned through McLaren Special Operations, developed with the team over 18 months.
Has described his classic Lamborghini Miura as the car he is most proud to own.

name: Nick Mason
bio: Founding drummer of Pink Floyd and a renowned historic-racing enthusiast and car collector.

cars.story: Has owned his 1962 Ferrari 250 GTO since the 1970s and regularly demonstrates it at events such as the Goodwood Revival.
Acquired a 1996-specification McLaren F1 GTR directly from McLaren in 1999 and kept it for more than 25 years before it was offered at RM Sotheby's Monterey sale in 2026.

name: Jay Kay
bio: Frontman of the British funk and acid-jazz band Jamiroquai and a well-known supercar enthusiast.

cars.story: Ordered a LaFerrari in a unique Signal Green finish, believed to be the only one in that colour; he took delivery in 2014 and sold it in 2019.
Has owned a black Ferrari Enzo, the car that inspired the Jamiroquai song "Black Devil Car".
Showed off his new Gordon Murray Automotive T.50 in a video on Jamiroquai's Instagram, calling it "the finest V12 car in the world".

name: Drake
bio: Canadian rapper, singer and songwriter, one of the best-selling music artists of his generation.

cars.story: Collaborated with Chrome Hearts on a one-of-a-kind Rolls-Royce Cullinan, revealed in 2021 around the release of Certified Lover Boy.
Reported in 2019 to have added a Mercedes-Maybach G 650 Landaulet, one of 99 built, to his fleet.
Reported to have owned a rare Mercedes-Maybach S 600 Pullman since 2015, a car he has referenced in his lyrics.

name: Rowan Atkinson
bio: English actor and comedian best known for Mr. Bean and Blackadder, and a long-standing motoring enthusiast.

cars.story: Bought a McLaren F1 new in 1997 and drove it regularly for around 17 years before selling it in 2015.
Owned a 2012 Lexus LFA, which was offered for sale in 2024 with under 5,000 km on the clock.

name: Gordon Ramsay
bio: British chef, restaurateur and television personality whose restaurants have earned multiple Michelin stars.

cars.story: Took delivery of one of the first LaFerrari Apertas in the UK in November 2016, finished in pearlescent white and handed over by H.R. Owen.
Reported to own a Ferrari Monza SP2 in black with a red stripe, one of 499 SP1 and SP2 models built.

name: Kevin Hart
bio: American stand-up comedian, actor and producer known for films such as Jumanji and Central Intelligence.

cars.story: Showed off his new Ferrari SF90 Spider on Instagram in 2021, saying it was the first delivered in the United States.
Reported in 2021 to have added a Ferrari 488 Pista to a collection that already included several Ferraris.

name: Shah Rukh Khan
bio: Indian actor and producer, one of the most successful stars in the history of Hindi cinema.

cars.story: Reported to have bought a Rolls-Royce Cullinan Black Badge in Arctic White in 2023, following the success of Pathaan.
A Rolls-Royce Phantom Drophead Coupé is reported to be among the most prized cars in his garage.
His garage is reported to include a Bentley Continental GT coupé.

name: Ranveer Singh
bio: Indian actor known for films such as Padmaavat, Gully Boy and 83.

cars.story: Gifted himself a matte-white Aston Martin Rapide S on his 32nd birthday in July 2017.
Reported to have bought a Lamborghini Urus in the Pearl Capsule design edition in May 2021.
Took delivery of a Mercedes-Maybach GLS 600 in Cavansite Blue as a birthday gift to himself in July 2021, shortly after its India launch.

name: Virat Kohli
bio: Former India captain and one of the most prolific batters in international cricket.

cars.story: Reported in 2018 to have added a Bentley Continental GT to his car collection.
A Bentley Flying Spur is reported to be among his most prized drives.
Reported to own an Audi R8 LMX, a limited-edition supercar of which only 99 were made.

name: Hardik Pandya
bio: Indian all-rounder and captain of the Mumbai Indians in the IPL.

cars.story: Reported in March 2026 to have bought himself a Ferrari 12Cilindri after India's T20 World Cup win.
Added a yellow Lamborghini Urus SE, the brand's first plug-in hybrid SUV, to his garage.
His collection is reported to include a V10-powered Lamborghini Huracán EVO.
